name: Script_TriggerEventObject
signature: bool Script_TriggerEventObject(char* name, int id, u32 value)

evidence: The only caller is the confident Ui_PaneCrossFade_Update, i.e. a crossfade pane triggers a named event when a pane finishes/advances; the lookup-and-trigger body and bool return are readable. Only the registry internals remain undocumented.

name: Menu_IconModelLoadTask_Update
summary: Step function of an asynchronous icon-model load job: in state 1 it polls the handle table 0x007BA2D0 and waits while the child object is below state 4, launches the load with Menu_IconModel_LoadBch, then finishes/releases on failure or moves to state 2/3.
evidence: The two callees are the confident Menu_IconModel_LoadBch and Menu_IconModel_Release and the caller is the named Menu teardown window, so this is a Menu icon-model load job rather than a generic field task.

name: maybe_Ui_Object_Dtor
summary: Destructor of a small object that owns one smart handle: installs its vtable, releases the handle at +0x10 (with the handle-table validity test), unlinks the node and frees the block.
evidence: The body (handle release + unlink + operator delete) is fully readable and calls Pack_ReleaseHandle/Pack_ReleaseHandleEntry, but the vtable is still only maybe_g_nodeDtorTable, so the UI-object class is unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Gfx_Effect_ReplaceResource
signature: void maybe_Gfx_Effect_ReplaceResource(EffectSlot* self, u32* handle, u32 effectId)
summary: Re-points an effect slot at another resource: validates the tagged handle against the global handle table, resolves the owner effect by id, attaches the new resource to +0xF0, clears bit 3 of +0x7C, then walks the slot's sub-object list for the vtable-0x7C8584 node and re-applies the sprite pattern.
evidence: Every callee now has a name (Gfx_ResourceList_Attach, Gfx_SpritePane_GetPrimaryMaterial, maybe_Gfx_Sprite_SetupPattern), which confirms the replace-and-refresh reading, but the effectId path is only partly followed.

name: maybe_Container_HashMap_FindByNameB
summary: Type-checked registry lookup over the global hash table g_00713AE0/AE4/AE8: finds an entry whose vtable type id is 0x007E2018 and whose 0x40-byte key matches the request; returns the entry or 0.
evidence: The caller is now the confident Model_LoadHitEffectResources and the 0x40-byte comparison through 0x00123660 is visible, but the A twin is still only maybe_Container_HashMap_FindByNameA, so the B suffix/key contract remains unconfirmed.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_AttachNodeTransform
summary: Attaches a scene-node transform to the actor: validates the scene-object handle at +0x220, requires type byte 4, finds the node of the expected class in the owner's node list, attaches it through Gfx_ResourceList_Attach and copies the source node's two transform words (+0x140/+0x144) into the target, setting bit 0 of its byte +2.
evidence: The attach step is the named Gfx_ResourceList_Attach and the handle walk matches Container_HandleResolveAsType, but the remaining unaff_r5 shows Ghidra lost a register.

name: maybe_Gfx_ResourceList_PreloadType4
summary: Preloads a batch of 0x25 resources: validates every handle in the request block through the resource table, then walks them again and attaches each handle of type 4 so the referenced assets are resident; sets the done byte when finished.
evidence: Kept tentative because of the decompiler artefact unaff_r4 in the loop body; only Gfx_ResourceList_Attach is named and type 4's meaning is still unestablished.

name: maybe_Container_LookupType4Value
summary: Looks a handle up in the global object table; if the object exists and is of type 4, returns the value at its f_90->f_24 pointer.
evidence: The handle-table lookup against 0x007BA2D0 with mask 0xFFFFF is clear and calls the named Container_HandleResolveAsType, but type 4's semantic meaning remains unestablished.

name: maybe_Ui_Part_IsRenderable
summary: ANDs three gates: the part's own state through 0x00628898 (when f_94 is set), the flag byte +0x3C of the sub-object at f_B8, and a typed-handle lookup on f_E0 whose resolved object must have kind byte +0x78 == 4.
evidence: The caller is the confident Ui_SceneFlow_CanOpenScene (itself a gate) and the three ANDed conditions are visible, but the per-part predicate 0x00628898 is an unidentified Thumb entry, so 'renderable' remains an interpretation; the function returns a value.

name: maybe_Container_HashMap_FindByNameA
summary: Registry lookup by hashed name: derives the interned key, walks the object's registry list, keeps only objects of type 0x00713710 and compares their 0x40-byte key, returning the matching object or 0.
evidence: The hash-table scheme is clear and the sole caller Ui_WorldMap_LoadModels shows what the registry holds, but the name is generic: this is the engine's global named-object registry rather than a container class.

name: maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_UpdateBestItems
signature: void* maybe_Ui_EquipWindow_UpdateBestItems(BestItemSlots* self, u8 charId, u8 mode)

name: Ui_MainMenuText_SetWindowState
signature: void Ui_MainMenuText_SetWindowState(void* self, unsigned char* state)
summary: Applies a main-menu text screen state: creates/releases the state-specific sub-window, copies its colour/style block and dispatches a per-state setup, keeping the last state in f_78.
evidence: The now-confident Ui_ItemInfoWindow_Create, Ui_MainWindow_ShowPane, Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable and Mem_AllocAligned_2 callees plus the 14-case switch over the descriptor's 0x78 state byte confirm a main-menu state setter; individual case constructors remain unnamed.

name: maybe_Ui_Effect_Create
summary: Assigns the effect/resource selected by id to self+8: releases the old handle, lazily creates the 0x21C-byte pooled object (vtable 0x007829E0), resolves the id through Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple with a 0xC-byte descriptor and stores the new handle.
evidence: The two named callers treat the result as the pane/window's current effect, but the body is a handle assignment (release old, load by id, store) rather than a constructor, so 'Create' is the caller's wording.

name: maybe_Model_LoadVariant
signature: u32 maybe_Model_LoadVariant(UiModelSlot* self, u32 key, u32 variant)
summary: Loads a model variant: builds the name from the type byte at self+0xB (0x10 selects self+0xA) and the slot data at self+8, looks up the model, computes the frame size from self+0x20..+0x24 and assigns the loaded handle to self+0x20.
evidence: The only caller is maybe_Model_ApplyResourceAppearance and the callees (Fs_NamedObject_LoadSimple, Pack_HandlePair_MoveAssign, Anim_BuildMotionPackPath, Container_Vector_PushBack) fit a model/resource loader, but the divide-by-12 magic and slot layout remain inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_Pack_LoadLayout

summary: Opens a UI layout pack for a screen: builds the '<name>.pack' path with 0x006F0C10, opens/loads the pack and swaps the cached handle into self->f_828.
evidence: Ghidra could not recover the register arguments (unaff_ registers in the body) and there are no readable callers, so the '%s.pack' literal and pack-manager callees are the only support.

name: maybe_Ui_DebugMenu_SetPageState
summary: Debug-menu page-state switch: drives the 0x21C-byte debug page singleton, resets the cursor and calls the page/movie/script helpers, but no debug-menu literal or caller confirms it.
evidence: The body calls the UI context vtable +0x28 twice, lazily allocates the 0x21C-byte singleton with vtable 0x7829E0 and calls 0x6F1D50/0x1DB688/0x1DB924; the owning menu and exact state transition are inferred.

name: maybe_Ui_Scene_EnsureCreated
summary: Lazily creates the shared 0x21C-byte UI scene object (vtable 0x007829E0, the same object type 0x00623914 creates) when the init byte is set, then returns the negation of Ui_LoadingScreen_IsFinished, i.e. 'the loading screen is still running'.
evidence: The callees are now named (Ui_LoadingScreen_IsFinished plus the allocator/vtable pair used by 0x00623914), but the returned 'still loading' value means the name 'EnsureCreated' does not describe the whole contract.

name: Ui_PartySelectWindow_CommitSelection
summary: Commits the current party-select choice: fires the selection popups for state 0x231D, writes the four selected ids into the work block, plays the confirm sound and waits for the field-event system to finish.
evidence: Battle_Ui_UpdatePartyPanel and Ui_PopupEntry_SpawnFromTable are now confident names and the state value 0x231D plus the four stored ids are visible, which fits a commit step; the selected-entry struct f_18A..f_18D is still raw.

name: Battle_Ui_PartyPanel_Precheck
summary: Gate run before the battle party panel redraws: every member must be visible, not in state 8/10, not busy and have a sufficient HP/MP value, then the two equipped items of the row are compared by name and the panel is marked unchanged when they match.
evidence: The named caller Battle_Ui_UpdatePartyPanel and the member-count helper 0x00630DC8 confirm the panel context, and the 0x0011FFC4 string copy of two records is a 'did the equipment change' check; only the vtable +0x20 rule for item type 2 remains unclear.
